plan.archetype: Efficient area damage transitioning into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring area damage to remove followers, sustained damage, upgraded weakness and efficient block, high entry HP, and two useful potions. Avoid prolonged Ritual scaling.
plan.summary: Secure efficient attacks and area damage first, then scaling defense and draw. Remove Strikes after obtaining replacements. Fight elites only with adequate damage, potions, and recovery; preserve health for the boss.
